agent_identity_max_depth_ck.name: agent_identity_max_depth_ck

identity_instruction_person_said_nothing.name: identity_instruction_person_said_nothing_ck
identity_instruction_person_said_nothing.value: "identity_instruction"."wrote_it" <> 'a-person' or ("identity_instruction"."conversation_id" is null and "identity_instruction"."said" is null)

identity_memory_amendment_after_matches_.name: identity_memory_amendment_after_matches_act_ck
identity_memory_amendment_after_matches_.value: ("identity_memory_amendment"."act" = 'removed' and "identity_memory_amendment"."text_after" is null) or ("identity_memory_amendment"."act" = 'corrected' and "identity_memory_amendment"."text_after" is not null)

skill_version_bytes_ck.name: skill_version_bytes_ck
skill_version_bytes_ck.value: typeof("skill_version"."bytes") = 'integer' AND "skill_version"."bytes" BETWEEN 1 AND 65536 AND length(CAST("skill_version"."body" AS BLOB)) = "skill_version"."bytes"

skill_version_package_ck.name: skill_version_package_ck
skill_version_package_ck.value: ("skill_version"."plugin_id" IS NULL AND "skill_version"."package_version" IS NULL AND "skill_version"."package_sha256" IS NULL AND "skill_version"."package_manifest_sha256" IS NULL) OR ("skill_version"."plugin_id" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_version"."package_version" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_version"."package_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_version"."package_manifest_sha256" IS NOT NULL)

work_a_root_is_given_by_a_person_ck.name: work_a_root_is_given_by_a_person_ck
work_a_root_is_given_by_a_person_ck.value: "work"."parent_id" IS NOT NULL OR "work"."given_by_session_id" IS NULL

work_a_piece_has_a_title_and_a_brief_ck.name: work_a_piece_has_a_title_and_a_brief_ck
work_a_piece_has_a_title_and_a_brief_ck.value: "work"."parent_id" IS NULL OR ("work"."title" IS NOT NULL AND "work"."brief" IS NOT NULL)
